scope: Freeze an exact V10F terrain-engine reference pack with source revisions, inspected paths, license boundaries, adopted concepts and rejected imports.
Extract accepted V10 and V10E surface construction behind a product-owned generator seam without changing their authoritative terrain or RNG output.
Implement an unselected deterministic prototype that emits exactly eight integer surface-grammar candidates per normalized seed using independently tagged parameters.
Define Twin Crests, Asymmetric Rampart, Trench Needle and Stepping Mesa as machine-readable 32-column recipe families with normalized generated ASCII previews.
Freeze the operation semantics, 32-to-256-column compilation, gameplay admission, deterministic ranking, fallback, replay and phone-preview boundaries before adding a runtime ruleset.
non_goals: No external code, algorithm implementation, map, template, constant, identifier, image, tile or asset is copied or imported.
No WFC or property-testing dependency is added, and package.json and package-lock.json remain unchanged.
No new ruleset, replay schema, browser preview, server profile, database path, reward behavior or public selector is added in the preparation stage.
No free-form Markdown or ASCII parser becomes gameplay authority; normalized ASCII is generated from a typed product recipe for review.
No cave, overhang, floating island, lethal gap, obstacle layer, movement rewrite or terrain-rendering rewrite is added.
planned_checks: Run the change selector dry run and selected verification over the complete preparation slice.
Run TypeScript checks and focused V10 simulation tests, including the accepted canonical V10 state hashes and deterministic grammar corpus.
Run compliance, diff checks and housekeeping to validate reference records, source boundaries and package tracking.
Directly review the complete diff for legacy compatibility, bounded generation, documentation accuracy and absence of runtime activation.
For the next implementation stage, snapshot normalized ASCII and compiled heights for all four recipes and test every operation boundary, reflection, opening role and family-specific gameplay gate.

check_results.command: npm run verify:changes -- --dry-run; npm run verify:changes
check_results.detail: The selector chose compliance, both TypeScript projects, tooling, protocol, simulation, Loomkeeper, Relic, combat, Practice, identity and reward tests, production outputs, four built-runtime smokes, bundle/security checks and the canonical Chromium phone phase. All selected checks passed: 109 tooling, 124 protocol, 146 simulation, 37 Loomkeeper, 10 Relic, 78 combat, 42 Practice, 22 identity and 37 reward tests; browser results were 59 passed and three reviewed route exclusions.

Both TypeScript projects pass. The focused ten-test V10 file preserves all six accepted canonical V10 state hashes and verifies deterministic bounded grammar output across seeds 1 through 48 plus 0x13579BDF, 0xC0FFEE11 and 0xDEADBEEF at all eight candidate indices.

check_results.command: npm run check:compliance; git diff --check; npm run audit:housekeeping
check_results.detail: Asset, generation-component, import-boundary, package-license, work-package and frozen-reference checks pass, as does the diff check. Housekeeping identifies WP-015D4C on the correctly named new branch with no gone tracking branches; its manual-reconciliation flag comes from preserved older in-progress packages and historical V9 failed reviews.

check_results.command: single-owner direct review of the complete WP-015D4C preparation diff
check_results.detail: The review confirmed that accepted V10/V10E generation is only relocated behind the new seam, the prototype is unreachable from runtime selection, every random parameter has a stable tag, generation has fixed candidate and operation counts, source/license records match the pinned references, and no external expression, dependency, asset, ruleset, route or public behavior was introduced.

skipped_checks: The selected PostgreSQL prerequisite did not run because WP014_TEST_DATABASE_URL is unavailable locally. This preparation adds no database or runtime authority path; CI remains responsible for that isolated gate.
The full five-project Ubuntu daily/release suite was not rerun. The existing 22:00 Europe/Berlin automation owns that gate; the selected canonical Chromium phase passed.
npm run assess:v10 was not rerun because the new grammar is deliberately not selectable by the V10 coordinator or assessment yet. Existing V10/V10E tests and all accepted V10 hashes pass.
No V10F physical-phone check was run because this preparation adds no V10F preview or player-visible behavior.
residual_risks: The prototype candidates are structurally bounded but are not yet admitted by movement, cover, attack/reply or replay gates and are not exposed to players.

The current prototype does not yet implement the four recipe families, `ridge`, `asymmetric-elevation`, the 32-column compiler or generated ASCII previews; those are the next V10F implementation stage.

The clean-room record remains observed under the historical schema; the single-owner policy permits direct implementation and review but this preparation does not claim historical separated-role closure.
V10E physical-phone terrain feel remains open while the owner has authorized proceeding with V10F preparation.
